name: Sister Carol ni Omakase! ~Toife no Sagashimono~
original_name: シスター・キャロにおまかせ!～トイフェのさがしもの～
source:
While Carole was busy cleaning, Toife was looking for something.
He seems to have lost something important.
Carole goes to his room to help with the search...

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/girls/work/=/product_id/RJ408553.html]DLsite[/url]]
translation:
当卡罗尔忙着打扫卫生时，托伊夫正在找东西。
他似乎失去了一些重要的东西。
卡罗尔去他的房间帮忙寻找……
